page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates exactly one thread per physical core, providing 128 vCPUs with dedicated CPU allocation to avoid resource contention.

The instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers across cloud resources.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound applications, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires architectural consideration for I/O-intensive tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance. This profile is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing workloads.
